parameters.query:
SELECT source_id, COUNT(*) AS uses, MAX(scheduled_date) AS latest_date, FALSE AS slot_reserved
FROM cuisine_social.posts GROUP BY source_id
UNION ALL
SELECT NULL::text, 0::bigint, NULL::date, EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM cuisine_social.posts WHERE scheduled_date = (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Paris')::date
)

parameters.query: UPDATE cuisine_social.posts SET status=$1, human_decision=$1, human_note=$2, decided_at=NOW(), approved_at=CASE WHEN $1='approved' THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END, source_snapshot=CASE WHEN $1='approved' THEN source_snapshot || jsonb_build_object('_social_approval_seal',encode(sha256(convert_to(jsonb_build_array(facebook_caption,instagram_caption,image_url,source_snapshot->'socialRights')::text,'UTF8')),'hex')) ELSE source_snapshot END, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$3 AND status='draft' AND approved_at IS NULL AND human_decision IS NULL AND NOT (source_snapshot ? '_social_approval_revision') AND source_snapshot->'socialRights'->'approved'='true'::jsonb RETURNING id,status,human_note
